en.s: Julia Soaemias Bassiana (180 – 11 March 222) was a Syrian noblewoman and the mother of Roman emperor Elagabalus, who ruled over the Roman Empire from 218 to 222. She was one of his chief advisors, initially with the support and accompaniment of her mother Julia Maesa. She and her mother guided the young emperor until growing unrest and a family division led to her son's replacement by her nephew Severus Alexander.

zh.s: 尤莉娅·索艾米亚斯·巴西安娜（180年—222年3月11日）是叙利亚贵族，也是罗马皇帝埃拉伽巴路斯的母亲。埃拉伽巴路斯于218年至222年统治罗马帝国。索艾米亚斯曾是儿子的主要顾问之一，早期与自己的母亲尤莉娅·梅萨共同辅佐他。后来，局势动荡、家族内部发生分裂，她和母亲对皇帝的影响逐渐减弱，埃拉伽巴路斯最终被她的外甥、后来成为皇帝的亚历山大·塞维鲁取代。

en.s: The Raid on Brandenburg was a Polish–Lithuanian raid on the Margraviate of Brandenburg in February–March 1326. With papal approval and encouragement, King Władysław I of Poland allied with Gediminas of Lithuania and organized the raid against Louis V of Germany. Pope John XXII opposed Louis' ambitions to become the Holy Roman Emperor, King Władysław regarded Neumark (East Brandenburg) as Polish territory, while Lithuanians sought loot.

en.s: The Battle of Castagnaro was fought on March 11, 1387 at Castagnaro (today's Veneto, northern Italy) between Verona and Padua. It is one of the most famous battles of the Italian condottieri age. The army of Verona was led by Giovanni Ordelaffi and Ostasio II da Polenta, while the victorious Paduans were commanded by John Hawkwood (Giovanni Acuto) and Francesco Novello da Carrara, the son of Francesco I, lord of Padua. John Hawkwood brought 1,100 of his own condottiere (600 cavalry and 500 archers, or vice versa depending on the source) to supplement the Paduan forces of 8,000 men (Giuseppe Marcotti places the number dismounted condottiere at 6,000 men, along with a reserve of 1,600 horse.

zh.s: 1387年3月11日，维罗纳与帕多瓦在卡斯塔尼亚罗（今意大利北部威尼托大区）交战。这是意大利雇佣军时代最著名的战役之一。维罗纳军队由乔瓦尼·奥尔德拉菲和奥斯塔西奥二世·达·波伦塔率领；获胜的帕多瓦军队由约翰·霍克伍德（意大利名乔瓦尼·阿库托）及帕多瓦领主弗朗切斯科一世之子弗朗切斯科·诺韦洛·达·卡拉拉指挥。霍克伍德带来自己的1,100名雇佣兵，补充帕多瓦的8,000人部队。不同史料分别将这1,100人记为600名骑兵和500名弓箭手，或相反的人数。朱塞佩·马尔科蒂则认为，下马作战的雇佣兵有6,000人，另有1,600名骑兵作为预备队。原文在此处中断。

en.s: The Battle of Valmont is the name given to two connected actions which took place between 9 and 11 March 1416 in the area of the towns of Valmont and Harfleur in Normandy. A raiding force under Thomas Beaufort, Earl of Dorset was confronted by a larger French army under Bernard VII, Count of Armagnac at Valmont. The initial action went against the English, who lost their horses and baggage. They managed to rally and withdraw in good order to Harfleur, only to find the French had cut them off.

zh.s: 瓦尔蒙战役指1416年3月9日至11日在诺曼底瓦尔蒙与阿夫勒尔一带发生的两场相互关联的战斗。多塞特伯爵托马斯·博福特率领的一支突袭部队，在瓦尔蒙遭遇阿马尼亚克伯爵贝尔纳七世指挥的较大规模法军。英军初战不利，丢失了战马和辎重，但仍重新集结，有序撤向阿夫勒尔，抵达后却发现法军已经切断退路。

en.s: The Battle of Joutselkä took place on March 11, 1555 in Kivennapa parish on the Karelian Isthmus during the early stages of the Russo-Swedish War 1554–1557. The battle has gone down in military history, because the Swedish commander Jöns Månsson skilfully utilised the terrain, the mobility of the skiers and surprise, thus replacing the large number of men.

zh.s: 尤特塞尔凯之战于1555年3月11日在卡累利阿地峡的基文纳帕教区发生，是1554至1557年俄瑞战争初期的一场战斗。瑞典指挥官约恩斯·芒松善于利用地形、滑雪部队的机动性和出其不意的优势，以较少兵力取胜，因此这场战斗在军事史上颇有名气。

en.s: The 1582 Battle of Tenmokuzan (天目山の戦い, Tenmokuzan no Tatakai) in Japan, is regarded as the last stand of the Takeda clan. This was the final attempt by Takeda Katsuyori to resist the forces of Oda Nobunaga, who had been campaigning against him for some time. In his bid to hide from his pursuers, Katsuyori burned his fortress at Shinpu Castle and fled into the mountains, to another Takeda stronghold, called Iwadono, held by Oyamada Nobushige, an old Takeda retainer.

zh.s: 1582年的天目山之战（日语：天目山の戦い，Tenmokuzan no Tatakai）被视为武田氏的最后一战。武田胜赖试图抵抗织田信长的军队；信长已对他展开征讨一段时间。为躲避追兵，胜赖烧毁新府城堡，逃入山中，前往武田氏的另一座据点岩殿城。该城由武田氏旧臣小山田信茂控制。

zh.s: 皮诺斯海战发生于1585年英西战争期间，交战双方是贝尔纳迪诺·德尔加迪略·阿维利亚内达率领的西班牙舰队，以及弗朗西斯·德雷克远征西属西印度群岛后残存的舰船。此时残余舰队由德雷克的副手托马斯·巴斯克维尔爵士指挥。战斗发生在皮诺斯岛附近，西班牙舰队获胜并俘获两艘英国船只。

en.s: The Daily Courant, initially published on [O.S. 11 March] 1702, was the first British daily newspaper. It was produced by Elizabeth Mallet at her premises next to the King's Arms tavern at Fleet Bridge in London. The newspaper consisted of a single page, with advertisements on the reverse side. Mallet advertised that she intended to publish only foreign news and would not add any comments of her own, supposing her readers to have "sense enough to make reflections for themselves".

zh.s: 英国第一份全国性日报《每日新闻报》最初于1702年3月11日（旧历）出版。报纸由伊丽莎白·马利在伦敦舰队桥旁创办，每期只有一页，背面刊登广告。马利表示只刊登外国新闻，不加入自己的评论，因为她相信读者有足够的判断力自行思考。

en.s: The Action of 11 March 1727 was a minor naval engagement of the Anglo-Spanish War. On 11 March the brand new Spanish 46-gun fifth rate warship Nuestra Senor Del Rosario was out on trials after just being fully completed. The ship was on a journey bound from Santander to Cadiz. Meanwhile, HMS Royal Oak detached on a cruise with the HMS Canterbury from the main body of a Royal Naval squadron reinforcing Gibraltar from a Spanish siege. They sighted the Spanish frigate near the port of Cadiz and gave chase. Soon the Royal Oak caught up, and after a few broadsides the Spanish warship soon surrendered.

zh.s: 1727年3月11日海战是英西战争中的一次小规模海上交战。当天，刚建成的西班牙46炮五级战舰‘玫瑰圣母’号正在试航，从桑坦德驶往加的斯。与此同时，英国皇家海军一支舰队正增援遭西班牙围攻的直布罗陀，‘皇家橡树’号与‘坎特伯雷’号脱离主力巡航。两舰在加的斯港附近发现西班牙护卫舰并追击。‘皇家橡树’号很快追上，发射数轮舷炮后，西班牙军舰便投降。

en.s: The Machecoul massacre is one of the first events of the War in the Vendée, a revolt against mass conscription and the civil constitution of the clergy. The first massacre took place on 11 March 1793, in the provincial city of Machecoul, in the district of the lower Loire. The city was a thriving center of grain trade; most of the victims were administrators, merchants and citizens of the city. Although the Machecoul massacre, and others that followed it, are often viewed (variously) as a royalist revolt, or a counter-revolution, twenty-first century historians generally agree that Vendee revolt was a complicated popular event brought on by anti-clericalism of the Revolution, mass conscription, and Jacobin anti-federalism.

zh.s: 马什库勒屠杀是旺代战争最早发生的事件之一。这场起义反对大规模征兵和《教士公民组织法》。第一次屠杀于1793年3月11日在下卢瓦尔地区的马什库勒城发生。该城是繁荣的粮食贸易中心，大多数死者是行政人员、商人和本城市民。马什库勒屠杀及随后类似事件，常被视为保王派起义或反革命活动，但21世纪的历史学者普遍认为，旺代起义是一场复杂的民众运动，起因包括革命中的反教权政策、大规模征兵，以及雅各宾派反对联邦制的立场。

en.s: The Battle of Mâcon (11 March 1814) saw a French division under Louis François Félix Musnier attack an Austrian corps led by Frederick Bianchi, Duke of Casalanza. The French enjoyed initial success but their numerical inferiority led to their defeat in this War of the Sixth Coalition clash. The Austrian army commander Prince Frederick of Hesse-Homburg soon pressed south toward Lyon. Mâcon is located 72 kilometres (45 mi) north of Lyon. As Napoleon dueled with the main Allied armies of Karl Philipp, Prince of Schwarzenberg and Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher to the east of Paris, a subsidiary campaign was fought near Lyon to the southeast.

zh.s: 1814年3月11日，路易·弗朗索瓦·费利克斯·米尼耶率领的一个法军师，在马孔进攻卡萨兰扎公爵弗雷德里克·比安基指挥的奥军军级部队。法军起初取得进展，但因兵力不足，在这场第六次反法同盟战争的战斗中落败。奥军统帅黑森-洪堡的弗里德里希亲王随即向南推进，逼近里昂。马孔位于里昂以北72公里（45英里）。当时，拿破仑正在巴黎以东与施瓦岑贝格亲王卡尔·菲利普和格布哈德·莱贝雷希特·冯·布吕歇尔率领的盟军主力交战，里昂附近的东南战线则进行着一场次要战役。

en.s: The Flagstaff War – also known as Hōne Heke's Rebellion, the Northern War and the First Māori War – was fought between 11 March 1845 and 11 January 1846 in and around the Bay of Islands, New Zealand. The conflict is best remembered for the actions of Hōne Heke who challenged the authority of the British by cutting down the flagstaff on Flagstaff Hill (Maiki Hill) at Kororāreka, now Russell. The flagstaff had been a gift from Hōne Heke to James Busby, the first British Resident.

zh.s: 旗杆战争又称霍内·赫克叛乱、北方战争或第一次毛利战争，于1845年3月11日至1846年1月11日在新西兰岛屿湾及周边地区进行。其中最为人熟知的是霍内·赫克砍倒科罗拉雷卡（今拉塞尔）旗杆山、又称迈基山上的旗杆，以此挑战英国权威。这根旗杆原本是赫克赠给首任英国驻扎官詹姆斯·巴斯比的礼物。

en.s: The Treaty of Waitangi (Māori: Te Tiriti o Waitangi), sometimes referred to as Te Tiriti (lit. 'The Treaty'), is a document of importance to the history of New Zealand, and its national identity. The cornerstone legislative recognition of the Treaty in the Treaty of Waitangi Act 1975 represented a paradigm shift and a radically altered official discourse, relating to Māori rights and the relationship between Māori and the Crown.
en.n: Flagstaff War: Unhappy with translational differences regarding the Treaty of Waitangi, chiefs Hōne Heke, Kawiti and Māori tribe members chop down the British flagpole for a fourth time and drive settlers out of Kororāreka, New Zealand.

zh.s: 《怀唐伊条约》（毛利语：Te Tiriti o Waitangi），有时简称Te Tiriti（意为“条约”），是新西兰历史和国家认同的重要文件。1975年《怀唐伊条约法》首次在立法中确认该条约，改变了官方对毛利人权利以及毛利人与王室关系的论述。
zh.n: 旗杆战争：由于不满《怀唐伊条约》的翻译差异，霍内·赫克、卡维蒂等毛利首领及部族成员第四次砍倒英国旗杆，并将定居者赶出新西兰的科罗拉雷卡。

en.s: The Second Battle of Nagyszeben (or Sibiu, or Hermannstadt) was a battle in the Hungarian war of Independence of 1848-1849 fought on 11 March 1849 between the Hungarian army led by the Polish General Józef Bem and the garrison of Nagyszeben, the Habsburg headquarters of Transylvania, composed by the Russian detachment led by Colonel Grigory Skariatin Austrian troops led by Lieutenant General Alois Pfersmann, and Transylvanian Saxon national guards.

zh.s: 第二次瑙吉塞本战役又称第二次锡比乌或赫尔曼施塔特战役，于1849年3月11日发生，是1848至1849年匈牙利独立战争的一场战斗。波兰将军约瑟夫·贝姆率领的匈牙利军队，与瑙吉塞本守军交战。该城是哈布斯堡王朝在特兰西瓦尼亚的总部，守军由格里戈里·斯卡里亚京上校率领的俄军分遣队、阿洛伊斯·普费尔斯曼中将率领的奥军，以及特兰西瓦尼亚萨克森人国民卫队组成。

en.s: Rigoletto is an opera in three acts by Giuseppe Verdi. The Italian libretto was written by Francesco Maria Piave based on the 1832 play Le roi s'amuse by Victor Hugo. en.s: The Constitution of the Confederate States, sometimes referred to as the Confederate Constitution, was the supreme law of the Confederate States of America. It superseded the Provisional Constitution of the Confederate States, the Confederate States' first constitution, in 1862. It remained in effect until the end of the American Civil War in 1865. The original Provisional Constitution is located at the American Civil War Museum in Richmond, Virginia, and differs slightly from the version later adopted.
en.n: American Civil War: The Constitution of the Confederate States of America is adopted.

zh.s: 美利坚联盟国宪法是美利坚联盟国的最高法律。1862年，它取代联盟国的第一部宪法《临时宪法》，并一直有效至1865年美国内战结束。《临时宪法》原件现藏于弗吉尼亚州里士满的美国内战博物馆，与后来通过的版本略有不同。
zh.n: 美国内战：美利坚联盟国宪法获通过。

en.s: Not to be confused with the floods in Sheffield in 2007. The Great Sheffield Flood was a flood that devastated parts of Sheffield, England, on 11 March 1864, when the Dale Dyke Dam broke as its reservoir was being filled for the first time. At least 240 people died and more than 600 houses were damaged or destroyed by the flood. The immediate cause was a crack in the embankment, but the source of the crack was never determined. The dam's failure led to reforms in engineering practice, setting standards on specifics that needed to be met when constructing such large-scale structures.

zh.s: 谢菲尔德大洪灾发生于1864年3月11日，与2007年的谢菲尔德洪水不同。当时，戴尔戴克水坝在水库首次蓄水过程中溃坝，洪水摧毁了英格兰谢菲尔德的部分地区，造成至少240人死亡，600多栋房屋受损或被毁。直接原因是坝体出现裂缝，但裂缝成因始终未能确定。溃坝促使工程实践改革，为建造这类大型设施时必须达到的具体要求制定标准。

en.s: Don Carlos is an 1867 five-act grand opera composed by Giuseppe Verdi to a French-language libretto by Joseph Méry and Camille du Locle, based on the 1787 play Don Karlos, Infant von Spanien (Don Carlos, Infante of Spain) by Friedrich Schiller and several incidents from Eugène Cormon's 1846 play Philippe II, Roi d'Espagne. The opera is most often performed in Italian translation, usually under the title Don Carlo.

zh.s: 《唐·卡洛》是朱塞佩·威尔第创作的五幕大歌剧，由约瑟夫·梅里和卡米耶·杜·洛克撰写法语剧本，改编自弗里德里希·席勒的戏剧《唐·卡洛斯，西班牙王子》及欧仁·科尔蒙戏剧中的若干情节。该剧由巴黎歌剧院委约制作，于1867年3月11日在勒佩尔蒂埃剧院首演，通常以意大利语译本演出，剧名多作《唐·卡洛》。

en.s: The 1876 Scottish Cup final was the third final of the Scottish Cup and the final of the 1875–76 Scottish Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland. The original match took place at Hamilton Crescent on 11 March 1876 and was contested by Queen's Park and 3rd Lanarkshire Rifle Volunteers. The match was the first final to be held at a neutral venue and also the first to require a replay to decide a winner.

zh.s: 1876年苏格兰杯决赛是该项赛事的第3届决赛，也是1875—76赛季苏格兰杯的最后一场比赛。苏格兰杯是苏格兰最负盛名的淘汰制足球赛事。最初的决赛于1876年3月11日在汉密尔顿新月球场举行，由女王公园对阵拉纳克郡第3步枪志愿队。这是首次在中立场地进行的决赛，也是首次需要重赛才能决定冠军的决赛。

en.s: Shō Tai (尚 泰; 3 August 1843 – 19 August 1901) was the final King of Ryukyu, initially as hereditary king of the Ryukyu Kingdom from 8 June 1848 until 10 October 1872 and finally as the Japanese appointed Domain King by Emperor Meiji, ultimately leading to his deposition and relocation to Tokyo by the Meiji Government on 11 March 1879.

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 11 March 1902 to elect the members of the state's Legislative Assembly. en.s: French legislative elections took place on 4 and 11 March 1973 to elect the fifth National Assembly of the Fifth Republic. In order to end the May 1968 crisis, President Charles de Gaulle dissolved the National Assembly and his party, the Gaullist Party Union of Democrats for the Republic (UDR), obtained the absolute majority of the seats. Nevertheless, the failure of his 1969 referendum caused his resignation. His former Prime minister Georges Pompidou was elected President of France. In order to respond to the discontent expressed during May 1968, Jacques Chaban-Delmas, the left-wing Gaullist who led the cabinet, promoted a programme of reforms for the advent of a "New Society", which advocated social dialogue and political liberalisation.

zh.s: 法国于1973年3月4日和11日举行议会选举，选出第五共和国的第五届国民议会。为结束1968年五月危机，戴高乐总统曾解散国民议会，其所属的戴高乐派政党共和国民主人士联盟随后赢得绝对多数席位。然而，1969年的公投失败导致戴高乐辞职，前总理乔治·蓬皮杜当选总统。为回应1968年五月运动表达的不满，主持内阁的左翼戴高乐派人物雅克·沙邦-戴尔马提出建设‘新社会’的改革方案，主张社会对话和政治自由化。

en.t: 1977 Washington, D.C., attack and hostage taking
en.s: The 1977 Hanafi Siege was a terrorist attack, hostage-taking, and standoff in Washington, D.C., lasting from March 9 to March 11, 1977. Three buildings (the District Building, B'nai B'rith headquarters, and Islamic Center of Washington) were seized by twelve Hanafi Movement gunmen, who took 149 hostages. During the initial attack and takeover of the buildings, the assailants killed a journalist and mortally wounded a police officer; three others, including a city councilor, were injured.

en.s: The coastal road massacre occurred on 11 March 1978, when Palestinian militants hijacked a bus on the Coastal Highway of Israel and murdered its occupants; 38 Israeli civilians, including 13 children, were killed as a result of the attack while 76 more were wounded. The attack was planned by the influential Palestinian militant leader Khalil al-Wazir (aka Abu Jihad) and carried out by Fatah, a Palestinian nationalist party co-founded by al-Wazir and Yasser Arafat in 1959.

en.t: Lithuania declares independence from the Soviet Union
en.s: The Act of the Re-Establishment of the State of Lithuania or Act of 11 March (Lithuanian: Aktas dėl Lietuvos nepriklausomos valstybės atstatymo) was an independence declaration by Lithuania adopted on 11 March 1990, signed by all members of the Supreme Council of the Republic of Lithuania led by Sąjūdis. The act emphasized restoration and legal continuity of the interwar-period Lithuania, which was occupied by the Soviet Union and annexed in June 1940.

zh.t: 立陶宛宣布脱离苏联独立
zh.s: 《恢复立陶宛国家地位法》，又称“3月11日法案”（立陶宛语：Aktas dėl Lietuvos nepriklausomos valstybės atstatymo），是立陶宛于1990年3月11日通过的独立宣言，由立陶宛共和国最高委员会全体成员签署。法案强调恢复立陶宛国家地位，并确认其与两次世界大战之间的立陶宛在法律上的延续性；苏联于1940年6月占领并吞并了当时的立陶宛。

en.s: A presidential election was held in Zimbabwe between 9 and 11 March 2002. The election was contested by the incumbent Robert Mugabe, Movement for Democratic Change leader Morgan Tsvangirai, ZANU-Ndonga leader Wilson Kumbula, Shakespeare Maya of the National Alliance for Good Governance and independent candidate Paul Siwela. Although Mugabe won, claiming 56.2% of the vote, it was the closest presidential election to date. Although the Organisation of African Unity described the election as "transparent, credible, free and fair", the conduct of the election was strongly condemned by the Commonwealth, Norwegian observers, Zimbabwean opposition figures, and Western governments and media.

zh.s: 津巴布韦于2002年3月9日至11日举行总统选举。参选者为现任总统罗伯特·穆加贝、争取民主变革运动领袖摩根·茨万吉拉伊、津巴布韦非洲民族联盟—恩东加派领袖威尔逊·昆布拉、善治全国联盟的莎士比亚·马亚，以及独立候选人保罗·西韦拉。穆加贝以公布的56.2%得票率获胜，但这仍是该国截至当时竞争最接近的总统选举。非洲统一组织称其‘透明、可信、自由且公正’，英联邦、挪威观察员、津巴布韦反对派人士及西方政府和媒体则强烈谴责选举的举行方式。

en.s: The 2004 Madrid train bombings (also known in Spain as 11-M) were nearly simultaneous, coordinated bombings against the Cercanías commuter train system of Madrid, Spain, on the morning of 11 March 2004 – three days before Spain's general elections. The explosions killed 192 people and injured around 2,000. The official investigation by the Spanish judiciary found that the attacks were directed by an al-Qaeda-inspired terrorist cell, although no direct al-Qaeda participation has been established. Though they had no role in the planning or implementation, the Spanish miners who sold the explosives to the terrorists were also arrested.

zh.s: 2004年3月11日上午，西班牙马德里近郊铁路系统遭到几乎同时发生、相互协调的多起炸弹袭击，距离西班牙大选仅剩三天。爆炸造成192人死亡、约2,000人受伤，在西班牙也称‘3·11事件’。西班牙司法机关的官方调查认定，袭击由一个受基地组织影响的恐怖小组策划指挥，但没有证据证实基地组织直接参与。向恐怖分子出售炸药的西班牙矿工也被逮捕，尽管他们没有参与袭击的策划或实施。

en.s: A Mauritanian presidential election occurred on 11 March 2007. Since no candidate received a majority of the votes, a second round was held on 25 March between the top two candidates, Sidi Ould Cheikh Abdallahi and Ahmed Ould Daddah. Abdallahi won the second round with about 53% of the vote and took office in April. The 2007 election followed a military coup in August 2005 that ousted long-time president Maaouya Ould Sid'Ahmed Taya; the head of the junta, Ely Ould Mohamed Vall, said that he and the other members of the junta would not run for president in the election, which marks the last stage of the transition to civilian rule.

en.s: The 2011 earthquake off the Pacific coast of Tōhoku (東北地方太平洋沖地震 Tōhoku-chihō Taiheiyō Oki Jishin) was a magnitude 9.0 (Mw) undersea megathrust earthquake off the coast of Japan that occurred at 14:46 JST (05:46 UTC) on Friday 11 March 2011, with the epicentre approximately 70 kilometres (43 mi) east of the Oshika Peninsula of Tōhoku and the hypocenter at an underwater depth of approximately 30 km (19 mi). The earthquake is also often referred to in Japan as the Great East Japan earthquake (東日本大震災 Higashi nihon daishinsai) and also known as the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake, and the 3.11 earthquake.

zh.s: 2011年3月11日星期五，日本标准时间14时46分（协调世界时05时46分），日本东北地区太平洋近海发生矩震级9.0级海底巨型逆冲地震。震中位于东北地区牡鹿半岛以东约70公里（43英里），震源深度约为海底以下30公里（19英里）。这场地震在日本也常称‘东日本大震灾’，又称2011年东北地震或3·11地震。

en.s: The Kandahar massacre, more precisely identified as the Panjwai massacre, occurred in the early hours of 11 March 2012, when United States Army Staff Sergeant Robert Bales murdered sixteen civilians and wounded six others in the Panjwayi District of Kandahar Province, Afghanistan. Nine of his victims were children, and eleven of the dead were from the same family. Some of the corpses were partially burned. Bales was taken into custody later that morning when he told authorities, "I did it". On 23 August 2013, a jury at Joint Base Lewis-McChord in Fort Lewis, Washington sentenced him to life in prison without parole.

zh.s: 2012年3月11日凌晨，美国陆军上士罗伯特·贝尔斯在阿富汗坎大哈省潘杰瓦伊区杀害16名平民，另造成6人受伤。这起事件更准确地称为潘杰瓦伊屠杀。死者中有9名儿童，11人来自同一个家庭，部分遗体被焚烧。贝尔斯于当日上午晚些时候向当局承认‘是我干的’，随后被拘押。2013年8月23日，华盛顿州刘易斯堡的刘易斯—麦科德联合基地陪审团判处他终身监禁，不得假释。

en.s: A special election for Florida's 13th congressional district was held March 11, 2014, to elect a member of the United States House of Representatives, following the death of incumbent Republican Congressman Bill Young on October 18, 2013.
